sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must performed 
after fourty one thousands operating hours as indicated by H 41000 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Atef Mohamed Farg 
Amen,
reviewed by eng. Abdel Rahem Salem Mohamed Ez, tested 
by eng. Aala Hassan Abu 
Tabl, accepted by eng. Hassan Al Refaie Hesain, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Adel Abd el-Kader El Naggar, approved by eng. Mohamed Hamouda Al 
Sarag Ali Head Sector of Demiatta Power Station.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... etc
Unit must be out of service and generator is grounded.

The field current transmission system for the 
 generator type consists of:

items: Slip ring of the generator
Brush holder.

sections.text:
Required Maintenance 
(Unit turning gear or Standstill)

items:
Remove all carbon brushes. Plug in brush 
 holders. (See Fig. 3&4 )
Remove the brushes from plug in brush holders.
Inspect the brushes if necessary replace it.

Clean the plug in brush holder by a dry linen 
 cloth.

Make sure the spring of plug in brush holder is 
 good.
Clean the brushes by dry linen cloth.

Remove the carbon dust from the slip rings and 
 radial bolt by dry compressed air. (See Fig.5 )

Make complete grinding for slip ring (at 
 turning gear speed).

sections.text:
Note:
for unusual condition check the carbon brushes length should be checked 
during operation daily.
Precaution

items:
It will be necessary to wear high-voltage proof gloves for brush holder 
 removal from or insertion into the carrier ring while the unit is in excited 
 condition.

To insure proper field current transfer during 
 checks and maintenance activities while the unit is excited, remove only one 
 plug in brush holder at a time for each polarity.

sections.text: Removing Worn Carbon Brushes

items:
Remove plug in brush holder, keeping the handle 
 pressed toward the telescopic plunger.

Maintain brush in its guide by a film touch of 
 the finger against the force of the compressing spring.
Release handle.
Allow brush to slide out (as far as possible).
Loosen and remove telescopic plunger.
Remove brush from its guide.
Disconnect pigtail lug.

sections.text: Inserting a New Brush

items: Insert brush into guide.
Reconnect pigtail at cable lug.
Refit telescopic plunger.

Insert brush into guide against the force of 
 the compression spring.
Press handle.
Insert plug-in brush holder into carrier ring.

the equipment into Service

items: Disconnect the ground from the generator winding.

Lift up the tools, materials used, and safety fence with caution mark surrounding 
 the work area.
Finish the work permit.

Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must performed 
after fourty one thousands operating hours as indicated by H 41000 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Atef Mohamed Farg 
Amen,
reviewed by eng. Abdel Rahem Salem Mohamed Ez, tested 
by eng. Aala Hassan Abu 
Tabl, accepted by eng. Hassan Al Refaie Hesain, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Adel Abd el-Kader El Naggar, approved by eng. Mohamed Hamouda Al 
Sarag Ali Head Sector of Demiatta Power Station.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... etc
Unit must be out of service and generator is grounded.

Tools and Equipment
Tool Set kit

 drivers etc.
Dry air source
Work to be Carried Out
The field current transmission system for the 
 generator type consists of:
Slip ring of the generator
Brush holder.
Carbon brushes. (See Fig.1)
Required Maintenance 
(Unit turning gear or Standstill)
Remove all carbon brushes. Plug in brush 
 holders. (See Fig. 3&4 )
Remove the brushes from plug in brush holders.
Inspect the brushes if necessary replace it.
Clean the plug in brush holder by a dry linen 
 cloth.
Make sure the spring of plug in brush holder is 
 good.
Clean the brushes by dry linen cloth.
Remove the carbon dust from the slip rings and 
 radial bolt by dry compressed air. (See Fig.5 )
Make complete grinding for slip ring (at 
 turning gear speed).
Note:
for unusual condition check the carbon brushes length should be checked 
during operation daily.
Precaution
It will be necessary to wear high-voltage proof gloves for brush holder 
 removal from or insertion into the carrier ring while the unit is in excited 
 condition.
To insure proper field current transfer during 
 checks and maintenance activities while the unit is excited, remove only one 
 plug in brush holder at a time for each polarity.
Removing Worn Carbon Brushes
Remove plug in brush holder, keeping the handle 
 pressed toward the telescopic plunger.
Maintain brush in its guide by a film touch of 
 the finger against the force of the compressing spring.
Release handle.
Allow brush to slide out (as far as possible).
Loosen and remove telescopic plunger.
Remove brush from its guide.
Disconnect pigtail lug.
Inserting a New Brush
Insert brush into guide.
Reconnect pigtail at cable lug.
Refit telescopic plunger.
Insert brush into guide against the force of 
 the compression spring.
Press handle.
Insert plug-in brush holder into carrier ring.
Return 
the equipment into Service
Disconnect the ground from the generator winding.
Lift up the tools, materials used, and safety fence with caution mark surrounding 
 the work area.
Finish the work permit.
